data.name: BotDescription
data.value:
🤖 ChatGPT + images
Just type a question — the bot replies with conversation context. Menu: new chat, models, images (Yandex Art / GPT Image), photo animation, combine, redraw, account and ⭐ top-up.
Free daily limits apply — see /profile. Details: /help

data.name: HelpText
data.value:
🤖 Full guide
🌐 Website The same ChatGPT chat and image tools are also available in the browser: https://gptips.skolkokomu.ru Sign in with Telegram — your ⭐ balance and quotas are shared with the bot.
💬 Chat with AI Just send a text message — the bot replies using the current conversation context. • 💬 New chat — reset context and start fresh • 🤖 Model — choose a ChatGPT model — GPT-4o mini: uses the free daily quota — other models: Stars only
🎨 Images Open “🎨 Images” in the menu: • 🖼 Yandex Art — free text-to-image (within daily quota) • 🎨 GPT Image · ⭐ — paid generation with size and quality options • 🛠 Edit · GPT Image · ⭐ — edit a photo from a text instruction; in groups: reply `/edit_image …` to a photo • 📝 Text from photo — OCR / extract text from an image • 💬 Prompt from photo — create a text-to-image prompt from an uploaded picture
You can also just send a photo (or reply to one) and ask a question — the bot can see the image, including tables and schedules.
💬 Prompt from photo Send an image — the bot writes a prompt that can generate a similar picture (uses ChatGPT quota or ⭐). In groups and comments: reply to a photo with /prompt_from_image.
✨ Animate photo Turn a photo into a short animation (free within quota or paid with ⭐).
🧩 Combine · Alice Merge two photos into one from a text description (uses the photo-animation quota or ⭐). Command /combine: first photo, then the second, then a description.
🖌 Redraw · Alice Restyle one photo with Alice (uses the photo-animation quota or ⭐). This is not “🛠 Edit · GPT Image”. Command /change_photo.
🧼 Remove watermark Removes captions, logos, and semi-transparent overlays from a photo (⭐ only, no free quota). The photo is regenerated, so small details may change slightly. Only remove watermarks from images you own.
👤 Account Shows your ⭐ balance, free quotas, and current model. From account you can: • choose a model • top up balance • switch interface language
⭐ Balance and limits Free requests are limited and refresh daily. When the quota is used up, top up ⭐ in Account or via /deposit. Guide: 1⭐ ≈ 10 ChatGPT requests, 2 image generations, or 2 photo animations.
Useful commands /start — main menu /help — this guide /profile — account /model — choose model /images — images menu /image — Yandex Art /gpt_image — GPT Image /edit_image — edit photo (GPT Image) /prompt_from_image — prompt from photo /animate — animate photo /combine — combine two photos (Alice) /change_photo — redraw photo (Alice) /remove_watermark — remove watermark /get_image_text — OCR /deposit — top up /reset_context — new chat /human — rewrite into simple natural English /donate — support the project
In groups: /ask, /human, /image, /summary
🔎 Inline (any chat) Type @GPTipsBot and a command: • ask your question — ChatGPT answer • image description — generate an image Example: @GPTipsBot ask What is a neutrino? Example: @GPTipsBot image a cat in space
Support: @my_super_ultra_smart_bot
